business.name: T&F Electric
business.tagline: #1 Pick for Electrical Services in Marion and all surrounding counties

services.name: Panel Upgrades
services.description: Upgrade your electrical panel to handle today's loads safely. Modernize old structures and add capacity for additions or new construction.

services.name: Generators (Whole Home)
services.description: Generac standby generator installation. Keep the lights on through Florida storm season, automatic transfer switches, full turnkey install.

services.name: Whole House Surge Protection
services.description: Whole house surge arrestors at the main panel. One install protects every circuit, every outlet, every appliance from lightning and utility spikes.

services.name: New Construction Wiring
services.description: Full electrical rough-in and finish for new homes, additions, and alterations. Residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial.

services.name: Lighting Installation
services.description: Interior lighting fixtures, ceiling fans, outside lighting and landscape lighting. Recessed, pendant, track, and energy-efficient LED upgrades.

services.name: Landscape Lighting
services.description: Low-voltage outdoor lighting for paths, trees, architectural features, and security. Designed, installed, and wired by licensed electricians.

services.name: Electrical Maintenance & Repair
services.description: Troubleshooting, repair, and preventative maintenance of existing electrical systems. Stop guessing, start fixing, before a small issue becomes an outage.

services.name: Modernization of Old Wiring
services.description: Rewire and modernize electrical systems in older Marion County homes. Bring your house up to current code, safely, with minimal disruption.

services.name: Additions & Alterations
services.description: Electrical for room additions, garage conversions, pool houses, and renovations. Permits pulled, inspections passed, work guaranteed.

services.name: Commercial Electrical
services.description: Storefront, office, retail, and small-business electrical. Service upgrades, tenant build-outs, and commercial panel work.

services.name: Agricultural & Industrial
services.description: Barns, horse stables, ag outbuildings, and industrial service. Three-phase, heavy feeders, and equipment circuits.

services.name: Phone & Online Tech Support
services.description: Quick troubleshooting by phone or video when you're not sure if it's a breaker, a bulb, or a bigger problem. Charges may apply.

testimonials.name: Jack C.
testimonials.quote: T & F Electric has done my electrical work for years. They're the only one I rely on in Dunnellon. Very prompt, great service, fair price.

testimonials.name: ALan G.
testimonials.quote: Our company went through several electricians before we found T & F Electric. Now we can finally stop looking for a company that always responds quickly, sends experienced professionals and can handle any problem, including replacing worn-out cables.

testimonials.name: Charles V.
testimonials.quote: Arrived on time and completed all work as requested.

testimonials.name: Joe N.
testimonials.quote: They kept their appointment and were on time. I didn't use them this time but was impressed with their professionalism and their knowledge of the electrical trade.

testimonials.name: Karen W.
testimonials.quote: Very nice young man installed the ceiling fans for me and I would recommend him to others.

testimonials.name: James E.
testimonials.quote: Upon contacting T&F Electric, the President of the Company came out in a timely manner to inspect the job site and review the requirements. Within 24 hours, I had a quote in hand. They arrived at the time they were supposed to and completed the job in a timely manner. They even asked if we had a vacuum cleaner they could use to clean up the work area. An excellent company I would strongly recommend.

testimonials.name: Leslie B.
testimonials.quote: Easy to work with, professional, and you can't beat the price.

testimonials.name: Elaine M.
testimonials.quote: They responded by phone while I was still online. Got the supplies needed and completed the job the following day. Fair pricing and fast service. Very satisfied.

testimonials.name: Denise Martinez
testimonials.quote: T and F is very responsive. They do great workmanship. Their team was friendly and explained things well.

testimonials.name: James Robinson
testimonials.quote: The only one I found that was reasonably priced. I needed power to a new 30x60 garage. They came and did the job as promised.

testimonials.name: Debra Stoffel
testimonials.quote: I had several estimates from other local electricians. T&F were awesome. Highly recommend.

testimonials.name: Tony Cruz
testimonials.quote: Best electric company in Marion County hands down. From customer service to execution and communication, the owner calls personally.

testimonials.name: Michael Johnson
testimonials.quote: Thank you so much for your fast response. Your company and technicians are awesome. If there were 6 stars you would have them.

featuredPromotion.offerText: Ask about Generac generator installation paired with whole house surge protection. One call protects the home when the next Florida storm rolls through.
